actions.description: The Audit Record provides substantiated evidence of compliance or non-conformance, clear impact classification, and actionable remediation actions -- approve it into the formal audit register
The Audit Record is unsubstantiated, misclassifies governance boundaries, or lacks factual verification -- reject it outright
The Audit Record requires additional evidence verification, clearer finding descriptions, or refined corrective actions before formal recording

metadata.decision_context: Given an Audit Finding or Audit Register entry, decide whether to approve it into the formal audit register, reject it, or request revision before deciding -- validating Stage 11 Audit Record

complexity_profile.rationale: Defaults to true for every policy in this template, learned from a real correction (ADPA's own approve-adr was first built with requires_human_approval: false, and the resolver's own execute_without_confirmation logic would have bypassed a real governance rule as a result). Correct this down per-policy only with real evidence the specific decision doesn't need a human sign-off -- never flip it the other direction speculatively.
